name: Stonelow Play Area
description: Play area at the junction of Stonelow Road and Shireoaks Road, refurbished in 2025 with inclusive equipment including an accessible play unit, roundabout, swings and a climbing rock, as Dronfield Town Council describes it. There's car parking on site.
